programme.title: Chicago: Volare Restaurant | Foodie On The Go
programme.desc: Chiquis visits Volare, a renowned family-owned Italian restaurant in Chicago, led by Chef Massimo, a Bologna, Italy native. Together, they prepare two of the restaurant’s most popular dishes: squid ink risotto with seafood and tiramisu.

programme.title: Solvang: Peasants Feast | Foodie On The Go
programme.desc: Chiquis explores Solvang, a town with deep Danish heritage in Santa Barbara County on California’s central coast, where she meets Chef Michael Cherney at the beloved Peasants Feast to try their infamous dish: the Copenhagen Caesar Salad.

programme.title: Los Angeles: Yang Chow Restaurant | Foodie On The Go
programme.desc: Chiquis goes to a popular Chinese spot in her hometown to find out what all the hype is about. While Benny, the manager, tells her the interesting story of Yang Chow Restaurant, she enjoys some of the best flavors she’s ever had.

programme.title: Miami: Versailles Restaurant | Foodie On The Go
programme.desc: Chiquis meets her dear friend Luly, Versailles founder’s granddaughter, for a Cuban feast! They talk about the work and sacrifices of the first immigrants in their families and how they carved the path for the following generations.

programme.title: Los Angeles: Mex Peru Gipsy | Foodie On The Go
programme.desc: Mex Peru Gipsy in Los Angeles was founded by Juan Alfaro in 1882. Chiquis joins Chef Felipe in the kitchen and learns how to make some of the specialties of the house: Tallarin Saltado and Lomo Saltado.

programme.title: Las Vegas: Sayulitas Restaurant | Foodie On The Go
programme.desc: Chiquis visits “Sayulitas” in Las Vegas. A family-owned restaurant that serves traditional Mexican food with a Filipino twist and discovers the inspiring story behind its huge success.

programme.title: Paradise Cove: Malibu’s Comeback Story | Foodie On The Go
programme.desc: Chiquis kicks off the new season at Paradise Cove, a legendary Malibu landmark restaurant. After a devastating January firestorm scorched the coast, owner Tim and Chef Pablo reopened their doors as a symbol of hope for the local community.

programme.title: Las Changas: The Backyard That Became a Movement | Foodie On The Go
programme.desc: Chiquis meets Chef Andrea, whose backyard restaurant in Sylmar, Las Changas, grew out of pandemic hardship and turned into a viral local treasure.

programme.title: San Diego: Abbey's BBQ | Foodie on the Go
programme.desc: Chiquis arrives in sunny San Diego to visit Abbey's BBQ, known for its irresistible brisket. The founders, Matt and Athena, show their decades of BBQ knowledge and leave its legacy to their children, who now run the business.

programme.title: Baja California: Restaurant Luis | Foodie On the Go
programme.desc: Chiquis takes a trip down to Baja California's "Lobster Village" to visit Restaurant Luis! Known for their delicious, fresh lobster!

programme.title: West Hollywood: Yamashiro | Foodie on the Go
programme.desc: Chiquis invites us to one of her favorite Japanese restaurants in LA: Yamashiro. In the 1920's, it was home to the 400 club welcoming celebrities from Hollywood's golden age. This Mansion is full of fresh ingredients and consistent quality.

programme.desc: Chiquis meets Chef Andrea, whose backyard restaurant in Sylmar, Las Changas, grew out of pandemic hardship and turned into a viral local treasure.

programme.title: Balancing Family & Fame | The Q Agenda
programme.desc: Family or fame: do you have to pick? Our hosts discuss the pros and cons. Actor Rafael de la Fuente opens up about how his pride has changed. Music producer Celimar tells us why Los Angeles is starting to feel like home.

programme.title: Making Queer Films & Characters | The Q Agenda
programme.desc: Are queer films always set in the same places? Our hosts get into it. Drag superstar Willam Belli shares how Drag Race fits into his dynamic career, and filmmakers Miguel Caballero & Luis Aldana share their origin stories.

programme.title: Perceptions of Love | The Q Agenda
programme.desc: Is queer love defiant? Our hosts get historical. Media personality Curly Velasquez joins the conversation and shares memories of his iconic abuela. Dancer and choreographer Carlos Irizarry opens up about working on Beyoncé's Renaissance tour.

programme.title: What Happened to Men? | The Q Agenda
programme.desc: Masculinity—it can be toxic and beautiful. Our hosts draw the line.

programme.title: Being Queer in Different Countries | The Q Agenda
programme.desc: Being queer and an immigrant has its many layers. Our hosts chat about the realities as a queer person in different countries—and Felix Alcaraz and Sonia Guiñansaca add their perspective to the table.
